entries.scope: Secure-development evidence, VM public API documentation, CVD guidance, accessibility evidence, and project statistics
entries.rationale: The VM resource policy and public option changed, and the security, CVD, generated API, accessibility, and learner-facing documentation must describe the validated behavior and evidence.
readerPaths: Repository entry to security index to architecture and executable evidence
Generated API entry to VM options and execution behavior
Security policy to CVD contact and safe reporting path
Statistics ledger to text-first Profile 2 trends
entries.navigationImpact: The security index links the new accessibility evidence; generated API navigation retains the existing VM types and adds the documented instruction budget.
entries.languageStrategy: Short learner-facing content keeps German first and English second at CEFR B2; machine values and generated identifiers remain language-neutral.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: macOS host evidence uses managed Node 24, pinned Playwright and axe, a loopback-only DocFX server, and independent Lynx dumps; later delivery gates cover the exact PR head.
entries.risk: Low after the passed local DocFX, axe, and Lynx cycle; API, theme, navigation, CLI/IDE, or workflow changes trigger re-evaluation.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: The VM API, diagnostics, learner documentation, CVD path, DocFX theme or navigation, CLI/IDE interaction, browser harness, workflow, or release surface changes.
